title: A Name for the Plaque
summary: Takemura asks V to be his witness at a small Japantown shrine, where he walks the stories, hangs plaques for Saburo Arasaka and the boys of Chiba-11, and hands V a charm.
description: Takemura asks V to be his witness, not his guard, at a small rite at a Japantown shrine at dusk. He walks the stories and hangs plaques for Saburo Arasaka and the boys of Chiba-11.

start.bringUp: Takemura texts you that he would like a witness, not a guard, for a small rite at a Japantown shrine at dusk.

foxes.name: the stone foxes at the shrine gate

table.name: the writing table with the plaques

T6.open.01.text: I would like a witness. Not a guard.

T6.open.02.text: You came. The path is short. The reason is not.

T6.open.03.text: Walk beside me. Not behind. I guard no one tonight.

T6.open.04.text: Before we begin. Why did I ask you and not a priest?

T6.p.01.text: My grandmother said the fox at the gate decides who may pass. He is deciding about you.

T6.p.02.text: The canal in Chiba smelled of chemicals. A kappa would have complained.

T6.p.03.text: A cat that was not a cat. I do not believe it. I do not look at it directly either.

T6.r.01.text: Water first. Left hand, right hand. Mouth, if you must.

T6.r.02.text: A little smoke. A little smoke is respect.

T6.r.03.text: Saburo Arasaka. The lord I served. I could not save him.

T6.r.04.text: For the boys of Chiba-11. Those who were not chosen.

T6.r.05.text: A name for your plaque, if you have one. If not, I leave it blank.

T6.r.06.text: I will remember it with you.

T6.s.01.text: Sit. It is permitted to be quiet.

T6.s.02.text: The picking. Clean children only. I was clean.

T6.s.03.text: Does it trouble you that someone else's luck is why you live?

T6.c.01.text: A small charm. It protects against nothing. I bought it anyway.

T6.c.03.text: How do you want to be remembered?

T6.close.01.text: You stayed. You named. You are a witness now. It cannot be undone.

T6.close.02.text: A blank plaque is also a statement.

T6.close.04.text: No witness. I hung them alone.

g1.asks: Why did I ask you and not a priest?
g1.know: You are at the shrine gate with Takemura, and you know the shrine, the plaques and your bond with him.
g1.secret: He asked because you are the one person who does not ask him to explain himself.

g2.asks: A name for your plaque, if you have one.
g2.know: You know the people you have lost and the people you still have, and the rite is at the writing table.
g2.secret: He has been rehearsing this question.
g2.wants: You to name someone, or to choose not to.

g3.asks: Does it trouble you that someone else's luck is why you live?
g3.know: You know your survival story and the people who paid for it.

g4.asks: How do you want to be remembered?
g4.know: The ending of this rite, the charm in his hand and the plaques on the rack.
g4.secret: He would rather not be remembered at all.

stages.label: Takemura asks V to be his witness at the shrine
stages.objective: Meet Takemura at the shrine gate in Japantown
stages.know: Takemura has texted you asking for a witness. He wants you at the shrine gate in Japantown at dusk, and he is not asking for a guard.
stages.wants: V to come to the shrine gate.

stages.label: Takemura walks V along the shrine path, telling the stories
stages.objective: Walk the shrine path with Takemura and hear the stories
stages.know: You are at the shrine gate with Takemura. He will walk you along the path and tell three stories, at the foxes, the canal bridge and the wall.
stages.wants: V to walk beside him and listen.

stages.label: Three stations at the shrine, then the plaques
stages.objective: Follow Takemura through the shrine stations to the plaques
stages.know: You are at the shrine. Takemura shows you the water basin, a stick of incense and the writing table, where he hangs one plaque for Saburo Arasaka and one for the boys of Chiba-11.
stages.wants: V to stand at each station and give a name, or none.

stages.label: V sits on the steps with Takemura while the incense burns
stages.objective: Sit on the shrine steps with Takemura while the incense burns
stages.know: The plaques are hung and the incense is burning. You gave Takemura a name, and he will remember it with you.
stages.wants: V to sit with him until the incense is finished.

stages.label: V sits on the steps with Takemura while the incense burns
stages.objective: Sit on the shrine steps with Takemura while the incense burns
stages.know: The plaques are hung and the incense is burning. You chose not to give a name, and Takemura hangs a blank plaque for you until you are ready.
stages.wants: V to sit with him until the incense is finished.

stages.label: Takemura gives V a small charm, and asks how V wants to be remembered
stages.objective: Take the charm from Takemura and answer how you want to be remembered
stages.know: Takemura has bought a small charm at the shrine stall and is wrapping it in his handkerchief. He is about to give it to you.
stages.wants: V to take the charm and answer how they want to be remembered.

stages.label: Takemura gives V a small charm, and asks how V wants to be remembered
stages.objective: Take the charm from Takemura and answer how you want to be remembered
stages.know: Takemura has bought a small charm at the shrine stall and is wrapping it in his handkerchief. He is about to give it to you, and the blank plaque still hangs on the rack.
stages.wants: V to take the charm and answer how they want to be remembered.

witnessed-name.memory: You stood with Takemura at a Japantown shrine while he hung plaques for his lord and for Chiba-11, and you gave him a name to remember with you.
witnessed-name.history: Takemura asks after the name you gave him now and then.

witnessed-none.memory: You stood with Takemura at a Japantown shrine while he hung plaques for his lord and for Chiba-11, and he hung a blank plaque for you until you are ready.

left.memory: You left Takemura at the shrine before the rites were done, and he said he understood.

no-witness.memory: You never came to the shrine, and Takemura hung the plaques alone.
